request.description:
**POST /studentHallTicket/generate**

**One-time only:** if any hall ticket already exists for that exam setup term + session (same institute/university), returns **400** — regeneration is not allowed.

Otherwise **creates** one row per eligible student (new QR each). **Requires at least one** `exam_schedule` row for that pair with **both** `examDate` and `examTime` (one scheduled subject is enough for Mid-term / End-sem, etc.).

**Body** uses folder vars `hallticket_examSetupTypeTermId`, `hallticket_sessionId`.

**GET /studentHallTicket**

Optional filters: **`examSetupTypeTermId`**, **`sessionId`**, **`studentId`** (folder vars). **Pagination:** **`page`** (default 1), **`limit`** (default **1000** if omitted; each request clamps **`limit`** to **10–1000**). Response **`data`** is the current page of hall tickets; **`paginationData`** has **`total`**, **`page`**, **`limit`**, **`totalPages`** (same pattern as GET `/questionPaper`).

**GET /studentHallTicket/:id**

Path id = `hallticket_hallTicketId`. Top level: student/session/exam-type fields; **`subjects`** lists every `exam_schedule` for this ticket’s term + session. Each item has flat fields (`subjectId`, `subjectName`, …) plus nested **`subject`** (full subject row: type, term, course, etc.) and **`semester`** when linked.

item.name: fee v2
item.description:
## End-to-end flow (run in order)

1. **feeTypeCategory** — CRUD fee categories
2. **feeTypeCatalog** — CRUD catalog lines (amount per category)
3. **feePlanProfile** — create plan + feePlanItems (terms) + optional feeTypeCatalogs per term
4. **student (fee v2)** — lookup plan → create student with feePlanProfileId
5. **studentFeeInvoice** — generate invoice per term (studentId + feePlanItemId)
6. **studentFeePayment** — record payment; updates invoice payment_status (unpaid | partial | paid)

## Legacy removed
- POST /student (old, feePlanId + auto mapper) — use **POST /student** with feePlanProfileId
- GET /student/:id/feeDetails — legacy mapper; use **GET /studentFeeInvoice?studentId=** for v2

## Tables (v2)
fee_type_categories, fee_type_catalog, fee_plan_profile, fee_plan_item, additional_fee, students.fee_plan_profile_id, student_fee_invoice, student_invoice_additional_fee, student_fee_payment

request.description:
Creates fee_plan_profile + feePlanItems (terms) + optional feeTypeCatalogs[] per installment.

Each feeTypeCatalogs[] entry: feeTypeCatalogId + amount (stored on additional_fee).

planType: annual | semester | trimester (lowercase). academicYearId optional.

**GET /feePlanProfile/summary** — dashboard cards on Fees Invoice page.

- **activeFeePlans**: fee_plan_profile with ≥1 student_fee_invoice (any term / fee_plan_item)
- **inactiveFeePlans**: profiles with zero invoices
- **allFeePlans**: total profiles for institute

**GET /feePlanProfile/all** — all fee plan profiles for your institute (no courseSessionId).

data: { feePlans: [{ feePlanProfileId, planName, planType, courseSessionId, term, termFees, additionalFees, totalFees, totalInvoices }] }

Query: courseSessionId (required). Response data: { courseSessionId, feePlans[] } with summary per profile: planName, planType, term count, termFees, additionalFees, totalFees, totalInvoices, instituteId.
Lightweight dropdown lookup. data: { courseSessionId, profiles: [{ feePlanProfileId, name }] }.

Query: feePlanProfileId. Returns plain JSON for the profile and nested feePlanItems → itemAdditionalFees → feeTypeCatalog → feeTypeCategory (includes createdAt/updatedAt where the model exposes them).

Body: studentId, feePlanItemId only. Creates student_fee_invoice + student_invoice_additional_fee rows from plan additional_fee lines.

201 message: "Invoice generated". data includes amount, total, totalVerified, additionalFees[], feePlanItem, etc.

Fees Invoice page table. No studentId/feePlan filter — all generated invoices for the institute. data[]: studentFeeInvoiceId, invoiceNo, studentName, scholarNumber, amount, paid, deposits, balanceDue, status (UNPAID/PAID/PARTIAL), paymentStatus, termName, createDate, dueDate.

Query: studentId (required). **V2 replacement for GET /student/:id/feeDetails.** data[]: studentFeeInvoiceId, termName, createDate, dueDate, amount, additionalFeesTotal, total, status, paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue, additionalFees[{ name, amount }].
Query: studentFeeInvoiceId. data: full invoice + paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue, additionalFees[], feePlanItem, total, storedTotal, totalVerified.
Body: studentFeeInvoiceId, paidAmount, paymentDate, paymentMethod; optional referenceNumber, notes. data.payment + data.invoice (updated paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue).
Query: studentFeeInvoiceId. data: invoiceTotal, totalPaid, balanceDue, paymentStatus, payments[].

request.description:
**POST /student** — fee v2 create.

**Required (validated):** feePlanProfileId, universityId, campusId, instituteId, affiliatedUniversityId, courseLevelId, courseId, classSectionsId, acedmicYearId, email, firstName, fatherName, phoneNumber, birthDate.

**roleId:** must be `"STUDENT"` (defaults to STUDENT if omitted); resolved to DB role_id for user permissions.

**Model field names (not aliases):** `admisssionDate` (3× s), `placeOfBirth` (not birthPlace/admissionDate). Entrance: `entranceExam`, `rollNumber`, `categoryRank`, `marks`.

Run **1 lookup fee plan profiles** first. Then **studentFeeInvoice → generate** per term.
